extracted.intended_audience: policymakers, scholars, journalists, donors, and members of the public looking for AEI research and publications
extracted.subtask_description: An index page enumerating the types of research products AEI publishes (reports, journal publications, one‑pagers, testimonies, working papers, speeches, etc.), the institute's centers/initiatives, and the policy areas used to organize content. It provides sample items under many product types.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Products — AEI mission & integrity
rubrics_metrics.description: AEI operates at the intersection of scholarship and politics, aiming to elevate political debate and improve the substance of government policy. Because many AEI research topics are controversial and scholars may have practical political experience, AEI maintains policies and procedures for assuring the integrity and reputation of its work and research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Statement of purpose and institutional commitment to integrity; no detailed policies listed on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Find content by research type — Reports
rubrics_metrics.description: Reports are AEI research products such as 'AEI Housing Market Indicators, April 2026' and other substantive analytic papers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples on the page include monthly indicators and topical analytical reports (authors and dates are shown).

rubrics_metrics.name: Find content by research type — Journal Publications
rubrics_metrics.description: Peer‑reviewed or journal articles authored by AEI scholars, e.g., papers published in Economica, Economics Letters, Harvard Journal of Law & Public Policy, Journal of Education Human Resources.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Page shows examples with brief summaries and author lists; indicates AEI scholars publish in external academic journals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Find content by research type — One‑Pagers
rubrics_metrics.description: Short single‑page summaries or excerpts, often commentary or concise summaries of research and opinion, e.g., items labeled 'One Pager' with short descriptions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples include editorial excerpts and short updates; format implies brevity and rapid commentary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Find content by research type — Testimonies
rubrics_metrics.description: Written testimony or comments to governmental bodies and commissions, e.g., testimony to the US‑China Economic and Security Review Commission and congressional committees.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Page lists multiple testimony examples with topic summaries and author attribution; these are targeted at legislative or regulatory audiences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Find content by research type — Working Papers
rubrics_metrics.description: Pre‑publication working papers or series items (AEI Working Paper Series and those from partners like NBER), presenting ongoing research and analysis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples include working papers on defense acquisition, demography, and other topics, with brief abstracts and authors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Find content by research type — Speeches
rubrics_metrics.description: Transcripts or summaries of speeches and public talks delivered by AEI scholars and guests, e.g., keynote addresses and forum remarks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples include event speeches with dates and short context descriptions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Browse by Product — AEIdeas
rubrics_metrics.description: AEI's AEIdeas product stream (likely commentary / blog‑style pieces).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a product category; no exemplar text beyond the product list on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Browse by Product — Articles & Op‑Eds
rubrics_metrics.description: Opinion pieces and articles by AEI scholars for public audiences and media outlets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a product category used to surface op‑eds and magazine/newspaper pieces.

rubrics_metrics.name: Browse by Product — Books
rubrics_metrics.description: Monographs and edited volumes produced by AEI scholars.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a product category; no individual book guidance on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Browse by Product — Research
rubrics_metrics.description: General research outputs from AEI across formats and topics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is a higher‑level product grouping; specific subtypes appear elsewhere on the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Browse by Product — Podcasts
rubrics_metrics.description: Audio/podcast productions from AEI scholars and programs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a product type; no episode guidance here.

rubrics_metrics.name: Browse by Product — Initiatives & Centers
rubrics_metrics.description: AEI houses centers and initiatives (e.g., Center on Opportunity and Social Mobility; Center for Technology, Science, and Energy; Housing Center; Critical Threats, etc.) that produce specialized research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page lists many centers/initiatives as product filters; each center curates content in its policy area.

rubrics_metrics.name: Browse by Product — The Survey Center on American Life
rubrics_metrics.description: A named AEI research center that produces survey research and reports (examples shown on page).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example one‑pager/report listed: 'Strangers Next Door: The Decline of Neighborhood Socializing and the Class Divide in Belonging.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Browse by Product — National Affairs / The American Enterprise
rubrics_metrics.description: AEI‑affiliated journals or long‑form outlets listed as product types.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed among product options for filtering content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Browse by Product — Events (Upcoming / Past)
rubrics_metrics.description: Event listings and archives (speeches, panels, forums) that are catalogued as AEI products.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to find speech transcripts and event materials; page shows event‑related speech examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Browse by Policy Area — Economics
rubrics_metrics.description: Content tagged under the Economics policy area, including research, reports, working papers and journal publications related to economics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Numerous example items on the page are tagged Economics (e.g., working papers, journal articles).

rubrics_metrics.name: Browse by Policy Area — Education
rubrics_metrics.description: Content on education policy, including agendas, studies, and testimony (e.g., 'Sketching a New Conservative Education Agenda').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples include multi‑author edited pieces and research related to K–12 and higher education.

rubrics_metrics.name: Browse by Policy Area — Foreign and Defense Policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Research and analysis on national security, foreign policy, and defense budgets (e.g., 'Can the Pentagon Embrace Commercial Acquisition?', working papers and testimonies).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples include working papers, testimonies, and analytic reports addressing defense and foreign policy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Browse by Policy Area — Health Care
rubrics_metrics.description: AEI content addressing health policy topics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a policy filter; specific items not detailed on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Browse by Policy Area — Housing
rubrics_metrics.description: Research on housing markets, indicators, and policy (e.g., 'AEI Housing Market Indicators' and commentary on affordable housing metrics).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Page contains multiple housing‑focused examples and center listings (Housing Center).

rubrics_metrics.name: Browse by Policy Area — Legal and Constitutional Studies
rubrics_metrics.description: Content on constitutional law and legal policy, including journal publications and testimony.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples include law journal articles and legal commentary shown on the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Browse by Policy Area — Opportunity & Social Mobility
rubrics_metrics.description: Research focused on mobility, inequality, and opportunity (e.g., reports from the Center on Opportunity and Social Mobility).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a policy area and center; examples include research reports and analyses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Browse by Policy Area — Politics and Public Opinion
rubrics_metrics.description: Research and survey analysis on political attitudes and public opinion, with items like survey center reports.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Survey Center on American Life is highlighted among product/center listings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Browse by Policy Area — Society and Culture; Technology, Science, and Energy
rubrics_metrics.description: Content addressing social and cultural topics and technology/science/energy policy produced by AEI authors and centers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed policy areas; example items for technology and China investment tracking are present.
